items.about:
I started out as an economist. Then spent 14 years in corporate. Finance. Consulting. IT projects. SAP. Oracle. The kind of roles where your day is mainly spent in spreadsheets.
 
The interesting part: I got hired for roles I wasn't fully qualified for. Because I was good at Excel. That was my edge. 
 
So when I left corporate and started consulting - Oracle Hyperion Financial Management - something funny kept happening. Clients kept pulling me aside to ask Excel questions. Not Oracle questions. Excel questions.
 
That told me something.
 
Excel is the tool everyone uses every day. But almost nobody thinks about getting better at it. Because you can usually make it work. Eventually. The day just gets longer. And more frustrating than it needs to be.

What most people don't realize is there are better ways. Especially now. Modern Excel has completely changed. New functions, new tools, automation that didn't exist five years ago. It's hard to keep up with. That's exactly what I teach.
 
Today, 500,000+ professionals from companies like Deloitte, Chanel, and Visa have learned through XelPlus courses - Excel, Power Query, Python in Excel, and Power BI. Our work has been featured by Forbes, CNBC, Nasdaq, the BBC, and Microsoft. I've held the Microsoft MVP title for 9 consecutive years.
 
On YouTube, our community has grown to over 3 million subscribers. 

What I cover: 
→ Excel (modern Excel, not the 2010 version everyone learned) 
→ Power Query (so you stop cleaning data by hand) 
→ Python in Excel (where data work is heading) 
→ Power BI (when your data needs professional visuals with drill-throughs)

And one more thing. A portion of every course sale goes toward sponsoring 30 girls in developing countries through Plan International. When you invest in your own skills here, someone else gets a future too.
 
If your organization is looking to upskill a whole team, we have a setup for that too.

Lora Cecere is the Founder of Supply Chain Insights. She works with supply chain leaders to take teams to higher levels of excellence.

Her research firm Supply Chain Insights is paving new directions in building thought-leading supply chain research.  Lora loves to write and research is in her veins. She is the author of the enterprise software blog “Supply Chain Shaman."  The blog focuses on the use of enterprise applications to drive supply chain excellence. Her co-authored book, Bricks Matter published in December, 2012 and her new book, Metrics that Matter publishes in December 2014. Lora writes monthly columns for Consumer Goods Technology and CSCMP Quarterly and actively blogs on LinkedIn as an Influencer and on Supply Chain Leadership on Forbes. 

As an enterprise strategist, Lora focuses on the changing face of enterprise technologies. Her research is designed for the early adopter seeking first mover advantage. Current research topics include the digital consumer, supply chain sensing, demand shaping and revenue management, market-driven value networks, accelerating innovation through open design networks, the evolution of predictive analytics, emerging business intelligence solutions, and technologies to improve safe and secure product delivery.

She comes to the stage with over 35 years of diverse supply chain experience.  She has spent nine years as an industry analyst with Gartner Group, AMR Research, Altimeter Group and is now the founder of her own firm.  Prior to becoming a supply chain analyst, she spent fifteen years as a leader in the building of supply chain software at Manugistics and Descartes Systems Group, and twenty years as a supply chain practitioner at Procter & Gamble, Kraft/General Foods, Clorox, and Dreyer’s Grand Ice Cream (now a division of Nestle).

When not working, Lora is taking ballet, training for the triathlon season, or cooking up something special in the kitchen. She also loves textiles and is an avid quilter and knitter.

currentPosition.description:
Is your CPG experiencing exponential growth, either organically or by acquisition? 

If you have issues in meeting your customers’ demand or in shipping or delivering on time, these are signs that your sales have outgrown your supply chain and you are at risk of losing millions in revenues and having huge costs in inventory. 

This is where I come in.

WHAT I DO:

🎯 📈 💰 🚚 📦 
I help fast-growing CPG companies to achieve greater EBITDA, revenues, lower cost, and improve cash flows through a USM Supply Chain. USM stands for Unstoppable, Scalable, Mindful Supply Chain. 

I follow a 5-step process:

STEP 1—Process Mapping:
I start with mapping the end-to-end finance supply chain planning process, to identify gaps, and measure current metric levels by adopting DMAIC and Lean Six Sigma.

STEP 2—Process Redesign and New Processes:
I align financial and supply chain metrics through the SCOR model, eliminate waste, minimize risk, and streamline processes BEFORE applying automation. A key area is inventory management and optimization. 

STEP 3—Automation with Macros in Excel and Robotics Process Automation (RPA):
I build macros in Excel that creates automation to significantly shorten the time to compile information from multiple sources, including SAP and Oracle, minimizing the manual input.

I also use RPA to eliminate high volume, repetitive tasks. Watch this video to know more: https://youtu.be/2ngKJB1vcfE

STEP 4—Data Visualizations in PowerBI Dashboards:
Link with a demo that shows the details in a fictional potato chip company: https://youtu.be/BcDvSSzhFqM

STEP 5—Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Training:
SOPs and training are critical to make the improvements sustainable over time and ensure consistency.

items.about:
Starting a business is no joke, let alone a CPG business

Managing its supply chain can be incredibly challenging between

-Finding a manufacturer that can meet your specs but give you a reasonable cost

-Ensuring your inventory is in a strong position - not too much inventory nor not stocking out

-Managing costs & cash closely to ensure that you’re working towards profitability

-The endless to-do lists & follow ups to ensure the supply chain is functioning properly

Founders are working nonstop to ensure their business is running smoothly, yet supply chain feels like an endless cycle of fire drills & barriers that take away from growing

At 1st, founders get their supply chains set up & assume the work is done

But then they get a call from their manufacturer saying:

-They are out of a raw material or
-Their warehouse is 3 days behind fulfilling orders or
-Pricing on a packaging component is going up w/ out warning

Sound familiar?

It’s clear their supply chain needs more dedicated support.

➡️ Micromanaging vendors - helped you feel in control, but time spent wasn’t sustainable
➡️ Overstocking on inventory to mitigate risks - now you’re sitting too heavy & tying up cash
➡️ Outsourcing tasks to a very junior team member - tasks got done, but they’re not getting ahead of future issues

You end the day feeling more overwhelmed than you started

Something has to change

If this resonates, please know you’re not alone

What you want is an supply chain expert to lead you through these challenges calmly & methodically who will solve your problems today and put structure in place that will ensure future fires don’t happen

Hi I'm Mary Kate, I do supply chain & ops consulting for growing brands

We offer reasonable, scalable solutions for growing brands to stop the supply chain fire drill cycle, give founders peace of mind & open up team capacity to focus on scaling the business

currentPosition.description:
Thanks for making it this far! 

It’s clear that supply chain is a pain point for your business and you may need some support in improving its performance.

We accomplished that with our client, a sexual wellness brand looking to step up their operational performance.

They faced a pivotal moment in their business where they wanted to expand their product portfolio and retail sales, but they were facing

-Frequent stock outs

-Poor 3PL performance

-High COGS

The first step we took to increase their supply chain’s capabilities was evaluating their current 3PL and placing them with a new partner…

And we discovered that their current 3PL was blocking them from strong wholesale relationships, building upsell programs, and overcharging them for poor service.

This is incredibly common in early stage CPG businesses.

Chances are they chose a supply chain set up that made sense for their business in the very early stages, but no longer made sense as they grew.

And most founders/early stage leaders don’t realize their supply chain is a problem until it becomes a problem. However, with expert supply chain support early on the business can bypass the bottleneck.

Once they:

🔥 Create redundancies on hero products
🔥 Build demand and supply planning methods
🔥 Identify scalable partners who balance cost and quality
🔥 Implement internal process for product development, ops and sales/marketing
🔥 Renegotiate contracts to ensure they are getting the best costs and payment terms

You’ll have a supply chain that is able to support your businesses growth plans and do so profitably.

So this is exactly what we did with with our client.

The result?

📈$260K in savings in year 1 by switching 3PLs
📈 Improved retailer relationships that allowed them to increase revenue 
📈 15% reduction in COGS on a hero product

Don’t let a ineffective supply chain costs push your bottom line into the ground.

With the right supply chain set up, you can get your business to the next level.
